title: Bunnie Xo Reveals She’s Been Accepted Into College Amid Jelly Roll Divorce
summary: The podcaster also teased on her podcast that she's crushing on someone new.
contentText:
Bunnie Xo is going back to school! At least, that’s what it looks like from the podcaster’s recent Instagram Story, which shows her acceptance into a state university following her split from Jelly Roll .

Related

Bunnie Xo Jokingly Compares Jelly Roll Divorce to Being Released From a 10-Year Prison Sentence

A Timeline of Jelly Roll & Bunnie Xo’s Relationship

Jelly Roll Files for Divorce From Bunnie Xo After Nearly 10 Years of Marriage

A few weeks after Bunnie and the country star’s divorce went public, the Dumb Blonde host shared a photo of her acceptance email from Arizona State University on Friday (July 3), according to multiple outlets. “Dr. Xo, loading?” she reportedly captioned the post, which was captured in screenshots.

It’s unclear what Bunnie might want to study, but it’s obvious that she’s entering a brand new era now that she’s single. After the news came out in June that Jelly had filed to end their marriage of nearly 10 years in May, the influencer explained on Dumb Blonde that while she felt blindsided by his decision — which was apparently prompted by an argument in which Bunnie had angrily dared Jelly to file divorce papers — she and her ex remain close friends.

She also said on the episode that Jelly has started dating, and in the latest installment of Dumb Blonde posted Friday, Bunnie hinted that someone new might’ve caught her eye, too.

“I might have somebody that I think is cute,” she said while giving an update on the countless men who’ve been shooting their shot in her DMs since her breakup came to light. “A new one. He’s pretty to look at, so I don’t know. And he’s West Coast. Love, love, love me a West Coast boy. He wants to come out here and see me, but I don’t know.”

Plus, Bunnie shared an Instagram video of herself rapping along to Eminem’s “Superman” — specifically the line, “Got no ring on this finger now” — captioned, “Oh she’s smiling again.”

Meanwhile, Jelly has been on tour in support of his 2024 album, Beautifully Broken , which reached No. 1 on the Billboard 200 . During a recent stop in Saratoga Springs, N.Y., he addressed his split from Bunnie on stage.

“Me and my wife are best friends,” he told his audience on June 18. “We will always be best friends. We just got off the phone earlier today. Nobody cheated on nobody. That will be my best friend forever … Bunnie, I love you, baby. Thank you for those 10 years.”
